_comment: The ready-made CV designs. layout: 'single' (one column) or 'sidebar' (left column + main). sections: order in the main column. side: sections in the left column (sidebar layout only; 'contact' is the contact block). footer: print the place/date/name line. ats: how well online application forms read it. See README.md in this folder for the HTML the stylesheets style.

templates.name: Classic
templates.good_for: Software, IT, engineering and any online application form
templates.description: One column, black and white, skills on top, dates on the right, photo top right. The safest choice for application portals.

templates.name: Modern
templates.description: One column with a soft grey header and blue headings.

templates.name: Sidebar
templates.good_for: A CV you send to a person by e-mail
templates.description: Dark header and a left column for contact, skills and languages. Looks good to a reader, but online application forms may read it out of order.

templates.name: Tabular (German style)
templates.good_for: Germany, Austria, Switzerland: traditional employers, public sector, trades and technicians
templates.description: The tabular Lebenslauf: dates in the left column, photo top right, place and date at the end.

templates.name: Academic and medical
templates.description: Serif and conservative: education and licences first, room for publications, more than one page is fine.

templates.name: Creative
templates.description: One accent colour, a large name and your portfolio link right under it. Still one column of real text, so forms can read it.
